entities.summary: Nikolay Vasilyevich Denin is a Russian politician who served as the governor of Bryansk Oblast from 2004 to 2014. He is a member of the United Russia party. Nikolay Denin was a performers & entertainers from Domashovo (b. 1958-05-15, Domashovo). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics. Its legacy: Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
